scope: Selected E-AC-3 JOC core mantissa quantization and packing; existing approved F12S semantics clarified, not new research algorithm

quantizer_inputs.coefficient: finite F32 from F09LB clipped staged row; strict outside [-1,+1] clip, equality preserves input word
quantizer_inputs.decoded_exponent: integer exponent value from normalized F09/F10 plan; F09 raw rows are I16 0..24
quantizer_inputs.bap: integer semantic BAP domain 0..15; BAP allocation/search is R1-owned
quantizer_inputs.subsequent_arithmetic: each indicated addition, subtraction and multiplication is a separate R32

authoritative_formula_clauses:
## F12S.5 mantissa 量化

进入量化前，FBW PRIMARY与LFE MAIN都必须采用F09LB提交的clipped staged coefficient row；不得重新读取未裁剪transform row。输入域、strict ±1边界和失败零提交规则见 `specs/09-lfe-gate-mantissa-boundaries.md`。

对每个谱系数 `coefficient`，先在 F64 中乘 `2^decoded_exponent`，再转为 F32 得 `x`。后续每个 `+`、`-` 和 `×` 都按 N00 单步 R32。整数转换向零截断，除非条款明确写 RNE。

- BAP 0：code 为 0，不写位。
- BAP 1、2、4：`code=clamp(trunc((x+1)×scale),0,levels-1)`。`(scale,levels)` 分别为 `(1.5,3)`、`(2.5,5)` 和 `(5.5,11)`。
- BAP 3：`raw=trunc((x+1)×3.5) bitand 7`。`raw=7` 时 trial 失败；否则 code 为 raw，宽 3 位。
- BAP 5：`raw=trunc((x+1)×7.5) bitand 15`。`raw=15` 时 trial 失败；否则 code 为 raw，宽 4 位。
- BAP 6～15：宽度 `w` 依次为 `[5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12,14,16]`。计算 `offset=R32(2^-w)`、`summed=R32(x+offset)`、`scaled=R32(summed×65536)`、`shifted=R32(scaled-0.5)`、`r=RNE_integer(shifted)`、`fixed=clamp(r arithmetic_shift_right 1,-32768,32767)`。`w<16` 时取 fixed 二补码低 16 位中的最高 w 位；`w=16` 时取低 16 位。

输入非有限、BAP 不在 0～15、保留 sentinel 或不能表示的中间结果使当前 trial 失败。

## F12S.6 分组和写入

每个 block 先按 `[L,C,R,Ls,Rs,LFE]`，再按各通道 bin 递增顺序，形成 mantissa item 序列。每个 block 重新建立三个独立分组器；分组不跨 block。

- BAP 1：按该 BAP 在 item 序列中的出现顺序每 3 个组成一组。缺项填 code 1。以 radix 3 累积，写 5 位。
- BAP 2：每 3 个一组，缺项填 code 2。以 radix 5 累积，写 7 位。
- BAP 4：每 2 个一组，缺项填 code 5。以 radix 11 累积，写 7 位。

分组字段写在该组第一个 item 的位置。该组其余 item 不写位。其他非零 BAP 在自身 item 位置写 F12S.5 的 code 和对应宽度。

group_code_formula.digit_order: first item is most significant; digits follow mantissa processing order

group_and_cost_contract.scope: three independent groupers per block; groups may cross channels in the flattened block sequence, never cross blocks/frames
group_and_cost_contract.emission: One group field is reserved at the first item of each group; later group members emit no bits. Grouped radix fields are MSB-first; partial groups use the published filler code.
group_and_cost_contract.mantissa_bit_cost: group_count(BAP1)*5 + group_count(BAP2)*7 + group_count(BAP4)*7 + sum(width_by_bap for ungrouped nonzero items); BAP0 contributes zero
group_and_cost_contract.alignment: no per-code byte alignment; bit writer is MSB-first

frame_budget.padding: zero-pad until exactly 34 tail bits remain

group_and_cost_contract.budget_failure: pre-tail body above 32734 bits is candidate infeasible; R1 owns search progression
group_and_cost_contract.limit_scope_guard: F12 declares no separate 4344-bit coefficient scratch limit; that value belongs to the distinct F05Q/JOC payload quantizer
group_and_cost_contract.bit_writer: MSB-first packed bit fields; no per-code byte alignment; each field advances the same bit cursor by its declared width.
group_and_cost_contract.trial_failure: Within a valid main F12 trial, capacity/BAP/quantizer sentinel/group/field failures make only that candidate infeasible; R1 owns search progression. No separate F05Q/JOC 4344-bit scratch limit is imported.

state_and_clock.grouper_state: block-local temporary only; no persistent group carry
state_and_clock.codec_eof_flush: none; F12 consumes complete source frames, with upstream frame clock outside this task
state_and_clock.transaction: R4 owns commit/state behavior; this package preserves the approved candidate failure boundary without re-deriving transaction logic
state_and_clock.frame_layout_crc: R3-owned; only the selected 34-bit reserve is used for mantissa bit cost
state_and_clock.frame_close: Zero padding reaches the reserved 34-bit tail when the pre-tail body fits. No codec EOF flush is added; R3 owns full frame close and CRC.

failure_boundary: Malformed external provider/type/shape fails the enclosing preflight as specified. Within a valid F12 trial, nonfinite values, out-of-domain BAP, reserved codes, unrepresentable intermediates or packing capacity make the current candidate infeasible per F12S.5/12; do not clamp reserved BAP3/5 codes or swallow producer fatal errors into candidate retry.
vector_encoding: Input vector coefficient hex words encode big-endian F32 bit patterns; not runtime memory byte order or a replacement wire endian rule.
budget_scope: 32734-bit limit includes all pre-tail fields, not just mantissas. Fresh writer/groupers per trial, reset groupers per block, never import the separate JOC 4344-bit scratch limit.
ownership: Stateless/local candidate calculations only. Allocation/search uses CODEC-ALLOCATION-PRODUCER-SEARCH-V1; source transaction uses CODEC-SOURCE-TRANSACTION-KEYLESS-PUBLICATION-V1; frame syntax/CRC owned separately. No DTHD or TrueHD prerequisite.
admission: Sufficient for implementation of this scoped existing approved contract. Source research package remains Wash-only; no claim of full codec or product readiness.
